predeclared_event_gate.conditional_predictions: If the independently matched child return dispatch remains h9.46988 and the 0.125h route is observed, predicted arrival is h9.59488 and 0.25h HOME PM completion h9.84488 within predeclared printed-time uncertainty. These are conditional cross-checks, never unconditional hardcoded timestamps, PM-work-start-equals-arrival, or fixed report-row directions. With later linked cycles, isolate the matched interval and derive all changed bins/cells from actual source-attributed edges; require the causal earlier return/regrant and complete 1754-cell reconciliation, not particular row19/20 values chosen in advance.
predeclared_event_gate.home_after_return: Require the attributed first lender arrival while its identified HOME PM wait is open, typed availability retest and P-MECH booking1 at BASE-02, bare PM subtask work0.25h, release and completion, and h12 terminal closure. Any later trips or PM/repair cycles must be grouped by task/subtask/transport identity and typed station receipts, parsed and fully reconciled in resource, system and all report ledgers. A later linked cycle does not fail merely because it exists. Unknown, overlapping, ambiguous or unlinked cycles are NO_GO; no one-lifetime-cycle assumption.
predeclared_event_gate.matched_control_prefix: Parse source-attributed typed events with indented log continuations. Identify the intended return dispatch by task ID, observed event line/order, stations, quantity and its linked outward/borrower-release/HOME failed-request/wait cycle. Compare all relevant pre-dispatch typed physical events to the accepted ordinary control, ignoring PDESC and raw file-byte layout. Never select the return by timestamp alone or require a global singleton at the same printed time. New or unmatched trip/loan cycle before that dispatch is NO_GO for the paired causal claim; later fully linked cycles are reconciled separately.
predeclared_event_gate.physical_conservation: At every event edge reconcile one P-MECH unit across BASE-02, outward transit, BASE-01, return transit and typed booking/free; P-CREW2 local, no overlapping or wrong-station booking. Group all observed transport creations/starts/arrivals/receipts and repair/PM starts/waits/bookings/work/releases/completions by task/subtask ID and source type, including later cycles; every edge must be linked exactly once. Derive all three aircraft system mission/repair/PM states and empty-stock/PNB baseline; never choose state from the child report.
predeclared_event_gate.return_branch: Identify the matched shortage-attributed return by transport task ID, P-MECH quantity1, BASE-01 departure after the corresponding borrower release, BASE-02 arrival and both station receipts, in the same cycle as the identified HOME PM failed availability/open wait. Require that child matched return departure-to-arrival is 0.125h within frozen printed-time uncertainty, versus accepted control 0.5h. Apply this positive duration gate ONLY to the matched return. A later fully linked return may print ordinary TTRS 0.5h or TTRSS 0.125h; parse and reconcile it without claiming which general rule chose it. A matched 0.5h return, changed pre-dispatch path, unmatched or ambiguous attribution is NO_GO. No persistent person-ID inference.

numeric_bounds.exact: Reject bool/nonfinite. All source metadata, instance names, column order, IDs, nulls, discrete counters, StockTotalResults 16 fields including baseline PNB, true source-fixed complete bins, zero FTMO, terminal state and unlisted fields exact. A numeric integer-valued elapsed duration may be fractional-expression-derived; classify by source and typed edges rather than observed value.

named_control_calibration_for_child.condition: Apply in the new child only if frozen HOME PM due h9, failed P-MECH availability at h9, open wait through the entire [9,9.5) bin, and same typed source-fixed wait state are independently established before looking at the report. This is a new prospective, predeclared child limit calibrated from the published control; it is not inherited v1.0.2 approval, is not additive to generic bound, and does not apply to any other field/bin. Reject 1.00001 and 0.99999.

numeric_bounds.propagation: Derive each expected cell from source constants and typed event state intervals. Combine algebraically cancelling edges first. B_time=sum(abs(c_j)*u(t_j))/D for signed state-jump coefficients c_j and the named denominator. Add B_serial=5e-7 only for genuinely computed nonexact fractional serialization. Never choose an edge, class, coefficient, tolerance or denominator from the candidate report. If an edge is unknown or B_time+B_serial exceeds its class ceiling, NO_GO.
numeric_bounds.time_print_uncertainty: For each genuinely printed, non-source-exact event edge t with d digits after the decimal, u(t)=0.5*10**(-d) hours. Source-scheduled opening h0, mission h8 and HOME PM h9 get u=0 only when their typed source/event linkage proves exactness; an integer-looking log string alone is insufficient.

reports_and_numerics.paired_contrast: Compare the identified physical loan/return/PM task and line edges to the accepted control. Under a matching pre-dispatch path, the shortage-attributed child return must be 0.125h versus control 0.5h and produce an earlier attributable lender receipt/regrant and PM progression. Reconstruct all child and control report cells from their source and complete typed event intervals, including any later linked cycles; derive changed fields/row directions from those intervals and reject unrelated or unexplained drift. Do not force fixed row19/20 values or raw report byte equality.
